```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the quotes data
quotes_data = pd.read_csv('quotes.csv')

# Define the list of tickers in our portfolio
tickers = ["SPY", "QQQ", "EFA", "EEM", "TLT", "IEF", "GLD", "DBC", "NVDA", "AVGO", "ORLY", "FAST"]

# Filter the data for the specified tickers
filtered_data = quotes_data[quotes_data['ticker'].isin(tickers)]

# Pivot the data to have dates as rows and tickers as columns
pivot_data = filtered_data.pivot(index='date', columns='ticker', values='close')

# Calculate the daily returns
daily_returns = pivot_data.pct_change().dropna()

# Compute the covariance matrix of the returns
cov_matrix = daily_returns.cov()

# Number of assets
num_assets = len(tickers)

# Array of ones
ones = np.ones(num_assets)

# Inverse of the covariance matrix
inv_cov_matrix = np.linalg.inv(cov_matrix)

# Portfolio variance of the minimum variance portfolio
port_variance = 1 / np.dot(ones.T, np.dot(inv_cov_matrix, ones))

# Weights of the minimum variance portfolio
min_var_weights = port_variance * np.dot(inv_cov_matrix, ones)

# Normalize the weights to sum to 1
min_var_weights /= min_var_weights.sum()

# Create a dictionary of weights
weights_dict = dict(zip(tickers, min_var_weights))

print(weights_dict)
